# Code of Conduct

> 🌐 Language: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.vi.md)

## Our standard

Be respectful, technically specific, and constructive. Discussions should focus on reproducibility, evidence, code, documentation, and user impact rather than personal attacks.

Unacceptable behavior includes harassment, discriminatory language, deliberate disruption, publishing private credentials, or pressuring contributors to expose private infrastructure or account data.

## Scope

This policy applies to issues, pull requests, discussions, release comments, and other project-managed collaboration spaces.

## Enforcement

Report serious conduct concerns privately to **Đăng Khoa <i.am@dangkhoa.dev>**. Maintainers may edit, hide, lock, or remove content and may restrict participation when needed to protect contributors and the project.
